original.statement: Between the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles, the Bucket source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 CRD schema makes status.artifact.digest required, so objects whose artifact has no digest are rejected.

decision.reason: The validators confirmed from the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] that status.artifact.digest becomes required in the Bucket v1beta2 schema, and the computed diff says objects that omit it are rejected. A nested required property is only checked when its parent object (status.artifact) is present. So the exposed state is a v1beta2 Bucket whose status.artifact is set but has no digest. P1's condition expresses exactly this state. The simpler 'digest unset' form would be too broad, because it also flags Buckets that have no artifact at all. Confidence is low: the evidence excerpts themselves show no schema text, and the canonical validator could not check this condition.
